ownership: Original AI-generated artwork commissioned for WorkPortal; no external artwork or third-party source image used.

seal.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: production bitmap for a birthday letter UI, a single realistic wax seal cutout on a genuinely transparent background.
Primary request: an exquisitely realistic dark navy / midnight petrol wax seal stamped with one elegant serif capital W, photographed directly overhead, physically believable wax and impression. This is a real wax object, NOT a flat logo, icon, vector, badge, sticker, illustration or 3D cartoon.
Subject: a near-circular 3cm-diameter puddle of deep navy sealing wax, slightly irregular softly rolled perimeter from hand pressing, small natural differences in thickness, subtle pooled wax at edge, a circular recessed stamping field, a clean impressed W monogram in the same wax material. Exact only text: "W". No extra text, no stars, no laurels.
Materials: restrained glossy wax highlights from upper left, fine physical surface texture and tiny realistic edge flaws, convincing recessed letter bevels and short occlusion shadows, deep indigo valleys and soft blue reflective ridges, premium old-fashioned correspondence.
Composition: single isolated centered complete seal, round and seen directly from above with negligible perspective, enough transparent margin for clean edges; no cut-off parts. The W is upright, horizontal baseline, readable when rendered 88 pixels wide.
Lighting: softly directional daylight upper-left, physically correct subtle speculars, no dramatic hard spotlight.
Constraints: genuine alpha transparency outside the wax; no paper, desk, hand, stamp, background, halo, white matte, checkerboard baked in, frame, drop shadow beyond a tiny natural contact edge, or watermark. Make it richly tactile and photorealistic, not ornate.

stamp.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: isolated realistic wax-stamping tool for a birthday letter press animation, genuinely transparent background.
Primary request: one photorealistic antique wax seal stamp tool standing upright, polished dark warm walnut turned wooden handle and round aged golden brass stamping base. Entire stamp visible from top knob to bottom rim.
Composition: a narrow vertical object, centered horizontally, tightly framed with transparent margin. Camera looking slightly down from the front, about 20 degrees above horizontal: we see the turned wood handle and upper shoulder of the circular brass base, but the actual engraved underside is facing downward and mostly hidden. The base must be a horizontal circular disk whose contact center is precisely centered below the handle. No diagonal tilt. The bottommost rim of the brass foot is the contact plane.
Scale/proportions: handle roughly 70% total height, base 30%, base is widest part. Image will display around 100px wide x180px high. Smooth elongated curved hourglass grip, rounded knob, narrow brass collar above a heavy round stamp head. The brass disk face diameter should be the full width of tool at the base, practical for pressing an 88px wax seal.
Materials: real fine walnut grain, restrained varnish highlights, believable slightly worn brass with finely machined concentric edges, golden reflection upper left, darker lower-right shading. Premium tool with honest physical texture, no ornate carved decorations.
Lighting: diffuse studio daylight from upper-left matching a dark navy wax seal.
Constraints: actual alpha transparent background. Only this one tool, no wax puddle, no seal impression, no hand, paper, desk, additional objects, dust cloud, text, logo, illustration, cartoon, vector look, baked checkerboard, white matte, ground shadow, or watermark. Straight upright orientation, exact center-bottom contact anchor.

processing: Preserve source PNGs. Production WebP: trim transparent margin to alpha>8 bounding box plus 2 source pixels padding; retain alpha channel; resize seal to width 384px and stamp to width 256px without enlargement; WebP quality90 alphaQuality100 effort6.
